what: Website-fingerprinting mechanism comparison for the AVPN/Mesh defense design, simulated by tools/mesh_wf_sim.py at the acceptance scale (100 sites). The vantage is the exit-side link - the one first-link-only defenses such as Mullvad's DAITA placement do not protect - where the observer sees timing and direction of constant-size packets after two hops of queueing jitter.

setup.world: closed world, 100 synthetic site profiles, 80 traces per site, chance = 1%
setup.vantage: exit-side link, after 2 hops of queueing jitter (sigma 12 ms per traversed hop)
setup.features: timing + direction: inter-arrival stats, burst-run stats, 40 time-bin histogram

defenses.client_only: constant-rate shaping at the client only (DAITA-style placement); downstream jitter erodes the clock
defenses.per_hop_grace: per-hop re-shaping, cover only after a 400 ms idle grace
defenses.per_hop_full: per-hop full constant-rate cover, duration rounded to a 4 s quantum
defenses.bidir_const_4s/8s/16s: bidirectional constant-rate streams on every link (the shipped posture), duration rounded to a 4/8/16 s quantum

reading.placement_dominates: the same constant-rate shaping scores 22.0% client-side-only vs 2.9% when re-shaped per hop; downstream queueing erodes a clock set only at the client
reading.direction_must_die: only the bidirectional streams remove direction as a feature; per-hop full cover with a direction-carrying stream still leaks (2.9% -> 2.2% at the same 4 s quantum, and the gap widens with the quantum)
reading.duration_is_the_last_leak: accuracy converges toward chance as the duration quantum coarsens: 2.2% at 4 s, 1.6% at 8 s, 1.4% at 16 s against a 1.0% chance level
reading.shipped_posture: bidirectional constant-rate cover on every hop (src/daita.rs cover machine + per-hop OS-seeded schedules) measures 1.4-2.2% against a 1.0% floor at 100 sites

limits: Synthetic traces and a classical classifier: this demonstrates mechanism and ordering at acceptance scale, not a real-world bound. The remaining acceptance gates (real traces, DF/Tik-Tok/RF attackers, cross-link flow confirmation, watermark injection) are Phase 1 lab work per docs/MESH_DESIGN.md section 8.
